findings: Fresh restart review confirms the collector must select the pinned classificator type shop/convenience before any brand classification.
Historical classifier code is not accepted by age alone; brand/operator/name fallback is revalidated against pinned Feature metadata behavior before reuse.
Pinned vehicle style renders generic convenience only from z17 and caption from z18, so stock presentation cannot satisfy the CB6 always-available brand-icon/no-text requirement.
No external web source is needed as implementation authority; exact pinned CoMaps source is sufficient for this restart stage.
FeatureType exposes types, names and metadata; classificator exposes path lookup; DataSource exposes ForEachInRect over installed MWM features.
OSM brand* maps to FMD_BRAND and operator* maps to FMD_OPERATOR; FeatureBuilder may drop FMD_BRAND when it duplicates a feature name, so brand metadata alone is not a complete classifier.
Pinned categories_brands does not contain the targeted Japanese convenience brands found by exact source inspection; CB6 cannot rely solely on the built-in known-brand dictionary.

Pinned vehicle style uses generic convenience-m.svg from z17 and adds convenience text from z18; CB6 brand-specific/no-text behavior requires an explicit CB6 presentation extension while preserving upstream behavior outside that requirement.
DataSource reads indexed features and metadata from registered local MWM files, providing the offline acquisition boundary.
Convenience POIs can be identified from Feature types and their names/metadata without a parallel network POI database.

Use shop/convenience as the gate, then deterministic brand/operator/name fallback because FMD_BRAND may be absent when equal to name and targeted Japanese chains are not in the pinned known-brand list.
Stock driving presentation is generic at z17+ and therefore does not meet CB6 brand-specific always-available presentation.
Pinned source supplies one generic convenience symbol; CB6 brand symbols must be explicit extensions rather than assumed upstream assets.
Registered installed MWM iteration through DataSource is the source-first offline acquisition boundary.
DataSource loads feature and metadata sections from local registered MWM containers; no network-only acquisition is required for static convenience POIs.
